novelty_basis: The Fibonacci length of a cyclic group is its Pisano period (classical; Knox 1992, Campbell et al.); nimber fields are Conway's.
proof_check: written proof (proofs/paper/C16.md Theorem 10, discrete logarithms in the field of nimbers); confirmed for q = 16, 256 (EXP-C16-03)
statement: On [0, q), q = 2^(2^k), with nim-multiplication the pair map sends pairs containing 0 to (0, 0) within two steps and is isomorphic on nonzero pairs to the Fibonacci pair map on (Z/(q-1))^2; its maximal period is pi(q - 1) (40 for q = 16, 360 for q = 256).
title: Fibonacci sequences of nimbers: maximal period pi(2^(2^k) - 1)
